message.content: {"question": "The temperature of a mass of 1 gr of iron is changed from 180 C to 200 C in atmospheric pressure. Calculate the change in internal energy ΔU of the iron mass. The specific heat of the iron is c=448 J/kgK, the coefficient of thermal expansion of iron is equal to λ = 1.1·10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ and the density of the iron that is ρ = 7.8·10³ kg/m³.", "options": {"A": "ΔU = 20.00 J", "B": "ΔU = 0.89 J", "C": "ΔU = 4.89 J", "D": "ΔU = 8.91 J"}, "correct": null}
